protocol_type: Layered, packet-based switched-fabric transport. A consumer posts Work Requests onto a Queue Pair through the verbs interface; the HCA segments the message into packets, each framed by a Local Route Header (LRH: SLID/DLID/SL/VL), optionally a Global Route Header (GRH) for inter-subnet routing, and a Base Transport Header (BTH: OpCode/QPN/PSN/P_Key); switches forward on the DLID and routers on the DGID; the destination HCA reassembles, validates ICRC/VCRC, and (for reliable service) acknowledges by PSN.

channels.name: Serial differential lanes
channels.direction: full-duplex (TX pair + RX pair per lane)
channels.description: 1x / 4x / 12x lanes carrying 8b/10b or 64b/66b encoded symbols at 2.5-100 Gbps/lane (SDR..NDR).

channels.name: Virtual Lanes (VL0..VL14 data, VL15 management)
channels.direction: logical, multiplexed over the physical link
channels.description: Independent buffered lanes for QoS / deadlock avoidance; SL maps to VL; VL arbitration shares link bandwidth; VL15 carries SMPs and is not flow controlled.

layer_stack.purpose: Queue Pairs, Completion Queues, verbs, RC/UC/UD/RD, BTH, PSN, end-to-end reliability.
Global Route Header (128-bit GIDs); inter-subnet routing by routers.
Local Route Header (LID/SL/VL), Virtual Lanes, credit-based flow control, VCRC; intra-subnet forwarding by switches.

addressing.LID: 16-bit Local Identifier; assigned by the Subnet Manager; switches forward within a subnet on the DLID.
addressing.GID: 128-bit Global Identifier (64-bit subnet prefix + 64-bit GUID); routers forward between subnets on the DGID.
addressing.QPN: 24-bit Queue Pair Number identifies the destination QP (QP0 = subnet management, QP1 = general management).
addressing.PSN: 24-bit Packet Sequence Number orders packets within a message and drives reliable-delivery ACK/NAK / retransmission.

service_types.name: Reliable Connected
service_types.delivery: connection between two QPs; acknowledged, in-order, reliable.

service_types.name: Reliable Datagram
service_types.delivery: reliable without a per-peer connection (End-to-End Context).

operations.semantics: channel (receiver consumes a posted Receive WQE).
memory (write remote memory; remote CPU not involved).
memory (read remote memory; remote CPU not involved).

valid_ready_handshake_rules: Consumer posts Work Queue Elements (WQEs) to the Send/Receive Queue of a QP via verbs.
Absolute credit-based per-VL flow control gates transmission on each Virtual Lane.
Reliable service (RC/RD) acknowledges by PSN with ACK/NAK and retransmits on loss or RNR.
Switches forward on DLID; routers forward on DGID; the SM establishes the paths.
Completions are posted as CQEs to the Completion Queue.

frame_format.framing: Packets are delimited at the Physical Layer (8b/10b control symbols / 64b/66b block framing); the LRH PktLen gives the length; VCRC terminates each packet.
frame_format.segmentation: Messages larger than the MTU are segmented into First/Middle/Last/Only packets and sequenced by PSN.
frame_format.note: VL15 management packets (SMPs) are framed identically but ride the non-flow-controlled management VL.
